title: Basic table import profile
description: Rules for a rectangular CSV table whose first record is the header. The service reports problems and, on request, writes a normalized copy. It never deletes rows or guesses values.

checks.title: Text and encoding
checks.description: The file must decode strictly with the selected encoding and contain no control characters other than TAB, LF and CR.

checks.title: Table structure
checks.description: The file must parse as CSV and every record must have the same number of fields as the header.

checks.title: Headers
checks.description: Headers must not be empty, must be unique after trimming and must be at most 128 characters long.

checks.title: Edge whitespace
checks.description: Reports spaces and tabs at the start or end of headers and cells; normalization removes them. A non-breaking space (U+00A0) at an edge is reported separately and kept by default.

checks.title: Declared identifier column
checks.description: When an identifier column is declared, it must exist and have no empty or repeated values. Values are compared exactly after trimming, so 00123 and 123 are different.

checks.title: Duplicate rows
checks.description: Reports data records that are identical in every field to an earlier record. Rows are never removed.

checks.title: Numeric identifier risks
checks.description: Reports identifiers with leading zeros or more than 15 digits, which spreadsheet programs may damage. Values are kept as text.
